action_zones.rationale: Fair value center blended from analyst consensus target ($401.75, 27 analysts), P/S at 12x trailing revenue ($313/sh), and Fwd P/E at 100x on implied forward EPS of $2.42 ($242/sh); blended center ~$319-$380. Hold range set at $401 ±15%, widened to $350–$460 to reflect beta 1.83. Buy Below anchored at 52-week low territory ($295) where valuation pressure-tests even the bear scenario on growth deceleration. Avoid Above at $530 reflects 1.3x analyst target with Fwd P/E >215x — beyond defensible bull case at current growth rates.

catalyst: NHTSA opens special FSD crash investigation after fatal Model 3 crash in Katy TX (Jun 22); Baird forecasts weak Q2 deliveries ~392.9K vs 410K consensus; UBS flags miss risk even at 405K; Tesla raises FY26 capex to $25B from $20B; Sunrun/Tesla 16 GW energy deal signed (Jun 24)
notes: First run baseline — price in lower hold zone, below all three SMAs, RSI 39 nearing oversold; NHTSA FSD probe adds regulatory overhang to near-term catalyst stack; Q2 delivery miss risk and capex surge pressure FCF; offset partially by improving QoQ metrics and low short float
